status: all DEV; mechanism / confound / boundary questions only; nothing confirmatory

M1.design: <=300 S1 sentences x {conf, tok, syn} vocab arms x {F + 6 operator mutants}; peers = 9 real outputs; frozen weights
M1.P1_DC_arm_gap: |AUROC_conf - AUROC_tok| < 0.02 and |AUROC_conf - AUROC_syn| < 0.02 (non-iso mutants); 'equivalent' if the 90% CI lies within +-0.03
M1.P5_iso_blind_spot: DC detection on L1-isomorphic (automorphic) mutants ~ 0.5 (CI contains 0.5)
M1.P6_L3_granularity_blind_spot (added by t: DROP_CONJ and ADD_CONJ detection is LOWER with L3 (DC) than with L2 only (DC_L2w): lexical-free definitions can absorb a dropped/added restrictor (Dog__s := Dog AND Brown). Predicted: DC per-op detection(DROP_CONJ) < DC_L2w per-op detection(DROP_CONJ)
M1.M1b: DC ΔAUROC over [B1, parse_ok, VC] 95% lower bound > 0 (panel); reported also over [B1, parse, VC, LC_maj]

M2.P2_rename_exact: FA(delta=0) = 0 for syn_rename, tok_rename, var_rename (name-independent ordering)
M2.P3_contamination: mean Δ(orig - para) CI includes 0 and |Δ| < 0.096 (B1's Δ)

M3.P1_dose: pooled detection >= 0.9 at k <= 2; in [0.3, 0.7] at k = 4; <= 0.3 at k >= 6
M3.P2_arb: DC+arb detection at k in {4,6,8} > DC detection at the same k
M3.P3_real_shared_bias: negative slope of within-sentence DC concordance on wrong_conc; detection < 0.5 in the top bin (>= 0.75)

M4.P1_cross_sentence: spurious EQUIV <= 2% on non-shape-isomorphic cross-sentence pairs; FLAG L3 if its increment > 5%
M4.P2_shuffle: within-sentence label shuffle AUROC ~ 0.5 (reported vs the signature's 0.648)
M4.P3_lexical_anchor: EQUIVs that are non-EQUIV under the trigram map are ENRICHED among panel-unfaithful items (manufactured agreement)

M5.P1_ladder: largest step lift in within-sentence detection is on added_condition
M5.P2_typing: DC contract typing weighted top-1 on panel-unfaithful items > majority baseline 0.249

M7.P1_goldflag: DC(gold) AUROC vs L0 gold_faithful_final > 0.5 (CI lower bound > 0.5); stacking with B1_gold/TJ_gold adds > 0

analysis_rules: 2,000 sentence-clustered bootstrap draws (stratified corpus x tercile for AUROCs); n < 20 per class = descriptive; iso mutants never pooled into primary AUROCs; failures reported, never fixed by changing the frozen config (amendments -> results/proposed_amendments.json)
